source_map.note: One page per card: intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/sku/<SKU>/<slug>/specifications.html (a plain request reads it). The page text writes superscripts inside the word: 'Intel® ArcTM A770 Graphics (16GB)'. Label and value are side by side without a colon: 'Memory Size 16 GB'. SKUs: A310 227958, A380 227959, A580 227961, A750 227954, A770 8GB 227955, A770 16GB 229151, B570 241676, B580 241598, Arc Pro B50 242615, B60 243916, B65 245796, B70 245797. Series tables: s16 (A), s17 (B: only B570, B580), s48 (Pro B: B65, B70, B50, B60). iGPUs: the host processor's page (no page of their own); label and value are separated by attribute residue, so quote them as 'label | value'.

'Vertical Segment Desktop' on A and B card pages. Arc Pro pages carry no Vertical Segment row (workstation is our classification from 'Product Collection Intel Arc Pro B-Series Graphics'). Processor pages: Mobile or Desktop; 'integrated' is our classification.

'Code Name Products formerly Alchemist Microarchitecture Xe HPG' (A), 'Xe2' (B and Pro B). Processor pages give only the CPU code name; the oneAPI guide s5 names Xe-LP (TGL = Tiger Lake) so only the Tiger Lake Iris Xe rows get an architecture. Xe-LPG (Meteor Lake) and Xe2 for Lunar Lake are not named on any page read.
'Launch Date Q3'22' style on every spec page.
Spec pages carry one 'Device ID' (processor pages: one or two). The fuller list is the dgpu-docs hardware table s9: it returns 0 characters of text to page.py (script-rendered), so it stays blocked.

'Memory Size 16 GB' on A cards; 'Memory 12 GB GDDR6' (size and type in one row) on B and Pro B cards. iGPU: shares system memory; processor page gives 'Max Memory Size (dependent on memory type)' for the whole processor.
'Memory Type GDDR6' (A cards) or the 'Memory 12 GB GDDR6' row (B cards). iGPU: processor page 'Memory Types ...' lists system memory.
'Graphics Memory Interface 256 bit' on every card page. iGPU: none.
'Graphics Memory Speed 17.5 Gbps'. B65 page has no speed row. iGPU: none.
'Graphics Memory Bandwidth 560 GB/s' on card pages and in the series tables. iGPU: Intel states none (only system memory MT/s and channels on the processor page).

'Xe-cores N' and 'Xe Vector Engines N' on Arc pages and Core Ultra processor pages ('Xe-cores 8'); 'Execution Units N' on 11th-13th gen and UHD processor pages. i9-9900K and i7-8700K pages (UHD 630) have no EU row.

'Graphics Clock 2100 MHz' on cards (boost or base not said). Pro B50 and B70 also give 'Graphics Max Dynamic Clock'. iGPU: 'Graphics Max Dynamic Frequency' differs per processor model (155H 2.25, 165H 2.3, 125H 2.2 GHz; 12900K 1.55, 12700K 1.50; 12400 1.45, 12100 1.40).
Only the Arc Pro pages (s28, s29, s30, s31) state 'GPU TFLOPS (FP32)'. Arc A, Arc B and processor pages state only 'GPU Peak TOPS (Int8)'; left empty there.

Arc and Arc Pro pages: 'Intel® Xe Matrix Extensions (Intel® XMX) Engines 512'. Processor pages do not list XMX for Meteor Lake or Arrow Lake desktop; for Lunar Lake and Arrow Lake H the SYCL matrix extension doc s47 lists XMX for architecture lnl_m and arl_h.

s47 'Intel XMX Supported Combinations': uint8/sint8 -> sint32, fp16, bf16 for architecture bmg_g21/bmg_g31 (Battlemage), lnl_m (Lunar Lake), dg2_g10-12 and arl_h. tf32 is not on the XMX rows of those architectures. s5 gives Xe-HPG 'int8 and FP16/BF16' for Arc A.
Only s5 (Xe-LP EU table, '32 (DP4A)') is usable, for Iris Xe. s22 lists cl_khr_integer_dot_product with two circles but the column of each circle is lost in the text, so it is not used.
s5: Xe-LP EU FP16 (Iris Xe); XMX fp16 for Xe-HPG (s5) and Xe2 (s47). Nothing for Xe-LPG, UHD 730/770 (generation not stated on a page) or UHD 630.

Card pages: 'oneAPI Support Yes', 'OpenVINOTM Support Yes'. Core Ultra processor pages: 'AI Software Frameworks Supported by GPU OpenVINOTM, WindowsML, DirectML, ONNX RT, WebGPU'. UHD / Iris Xe: OpenVINO supported-hardware list on docs.openvino.ai (s25, now readable). Driver stack: s8 compute-runtime lists the platforms. The oneAPI DPC++ requirements page s27 returns 403.

Card pages 'Vulkan* Support 1.3' (Pro B50 1.4). For UHD, Iris Xe and UHD 630 the Intel support article s46 'Supported APIs for Intel Graphics' (table row per product). The same article lists Intel Arc Pro B-Series at 1.4 whereas B60, B65, B70 pages say 1.3. Core Ultra Arc/Intel Graphics are not in s46: no official Vulkan row found.
'OpenCL* Support 3.0' on card pages and processor pages; s46 gives it per product (UHD 630: 2.1).
